title: Membership: declined first payment broke activation (fix pending commit)
description: collectFirstMembershipInvoice (src/lib/membership/finite-schedule.ts) checked error.name==='StripeCardError', but stripe-node v22 sets name='Error' and reports the class in .type, so any declined first payment rethrew, rolled back activation, and stuck the member on 'confirming' forever (replays hit the same idempotent decline). Fixed in the verify worktree via isCardDecline() + tests/membership-billing.test.ts (61/61 pass), deployed to the sandbox and verified hosted: activation recovered, past_due without access, access restored after paying. Needs commit to feat/membership-platform with owner approval.
close_reason: Fixed in c5c05bc on local branch feat/membership-decline-fix (based on a832ebf); verified on hosted sandbox. Push to origin/feat/membership-platform pending owner approval.

title: Membership: keep access through paid_through after mid-term cancellation
description: Owner decision 2026-10-09: a member who cancels mid-term keeps access until paid_through. Today cancellation sets status=canceled, and memberAccess (src/lib/membership/config.ts:50) only allows active/past_due, so access ends immediately even though paid_through is retained.

title: Membership: partial refunds should not revoke access
description: Today any charge.refunded (even a $5 partial refund) drops paid_through to null, removing all access. Recommended standard (owner to confirm): partial refunds leave access unchanged and are flagged for operator review; a full refund of a month's charge removes that month's coverage; disputes keep revoking immediately (current behavior, correct).

title: Membership: let revoked members re-enroll
description: Owner decision 2026-10-09: not intended that a revoked membership (dispute/refund) blocks a new checkout. createMemberCheckout (src/lib/membership/billing.ts ~line 29) rejects when an existing membership is not canceled/incomplete_expired and term_end is in the future; it ignores revoked_at. Treat revoked memberships as not holding a term for enrollment purposes (keep payment history and the revocation record).

title: Membership: Vercel Cron for webhook/email queue recovery
description: Membership branch has no scheduler: failed webhook/email jobs only retry when another Stripe event arrives (one job per delivery). Add a Vercel Cron (Pro plan, every few minutes) hitting GET /api/membership/process, which already processes up to 20 items and accepts CRON_SECRET as bearer. Set CRON_SECRET per environment (entered by owner, never printed). Add alerting on oldest pending job / failed jobs. Launch blocker per handoff step 5.

title: Membership: record failure reasons for webhook and email jobs
description: membership_webhook_jobs.last_error only stores error.name (often just 'Error') and member_email_jobs stores only provider-http-<status>, discarding Resend's message. Store a bounded, secret-free category + message (e.g. Stripe error type/code, Resend error name/message). Both the decline bug and the corrupted Resend key took long to diagnose because of this.

title: Membership: drain several queued jobs per webhook delivery
description: src/app/api/membership/webhook/route.ts after() calls processNextMembershipEvent() once, so each delivery clears at most one queued job and backlogs drain slowly. Loop a small bounded number (e.g. up to 5 within the time budget). Supplement to the cron, not a replacement.

title: Private conversations page should book through the existing /calls booking flow
description: On the membership branch (feat/membership-platform), /members/conversations currently only saves a request form (member_service_requests); it doesn't book anything or notify anyone. Matthew wants Champion private conversations to reuse the existing paid-call booking stack from /calls (src/lib/calls/: Google Calendar availability from CALLS_AVAILABILITY_CALENDAR_ID, busy calendars, slot selection) instead of a separate request form. Members already paid via the membership, so this needs a no-charge booking path gated on an active Champion membership, keeping the one-conversation-per-paid-month rule (unique index member_conversation_per_month). Note /calls bookings are currently paused on main. Offers/benefits are placeholders and may change.
